appDescription: KiloMoa turns everyday driving into rewards: briefing tickets accumulate per kilometre while driving, and short public-interest briefings play only while the vehicle is parked to earn credits.

function.name: CHECK_REWARD_BALANCE
function.description: Report the distance driven today, the number of briefing tickets available, and the current credit balance.

function.name: OPEN_KILOMOA
function.description: Bring the KiloMoa home screen to the foreground.
